product.digital_subtitle: Hide shipping options and deliver digitally
product.encourage_larger_orders: Encourage larger orders with shipping savings
product.free_shipping_info_body:
When enabled, the buyer pays $0 for shipping — you absorb the cost.

This is great for increasing conversions, especially for lightweight or high-margin products.

Tip: You can also offer free shipping only for bulk orders (10+ items) in the Delivery section below.
product.tax_code_learn_more: What is a tax code? Tap to learn more
product.stripe_tax_codes_body:
Tax codes tell Stripe which tax rate to apply at checkout.

Format: txcd_ followed by 8 digits (e.g. txcd_99999999).

Common codes:
• txcd_99999999 — General tangible goods
• txcd_10000000 — General services
• txcd_10201000 — Software as a Service (SaaS)
• txcd_35010000 — Clothing & apparel

Leave empty to use Stripe's default tax behavior. Find the full list at stripe.com/docs/tax/tax-codes.
product.digital_skip_shipping: Digital products skip shipping and delivery options.
product.digital_info_body:
Enable this for products delivered electronically — e-books, software, digital art, courses, etc.

What happens:
• Shipping is automatically set to free
• Delivery tiers and package dimensions are hidden
• No physical address is needed from the buyer

The buyer will receive the product through your delivery method (email, download link, etc.).
product.perishable_info_body:
Mark products that are temperature-sensitive or have a short shelf life — food, flowers, cosmetics, etc.

What this does:
• Flags the product for priority handling
• Buyers are informed about special shipping conditions
• Express or Same-Day delivery is recommended

Tip: Consider enabling Same-Day Delivery below for perishable items to ensure freshness.
product.standard_delivery_info_body:
The base shipping option for your product.

Pricing:
• Set Price to $0 for free standard shipping
• Or set your own flat rate (e.g. $5.99)
• If left at $0 and Free Shipping is off, distance-based rates apply

Days: Estimated business days for delivery (shown to buyers).

At least one delivery tier must be enabled for physical products.
product.free_shipping_banner: Free shipping is enabled — Express and Same-Day tiers are hidden. Standard delivery will be offered at no cost to the buyer.
product.express_delivery_info_body:
Offer faster shipping at a premium price.

Default surcharge: $9.99 on top of standard shipping.

When a buyer selects Express at checkout:
• Your price here is the base rate shown
• An additional express surcharge is applied automatically
• You keep the shipping revenue minus platform fees

Typical express timeframe: 1-2 business days.
product.same_day_delivery_info_body:
Offer same-day delivery for local buyers.

Default surcharge: $14.99 on top of base shipping.

How it works:
• Only available for buyers within your delivery area
• Orders must be placed before your cutoff time
• Best for perishable items, gifts, or urgent needs

Ideal for food, flowers, and time-sensitive products.
product.local_pickup_info_body:
Enable this if the product can only be picked up in person — no shipping.

What happens:
• Shipping cost is $0 for the buyer
• Package weight and dimensions fields are hidden
• A "pickup" delivery option is automatically created
• The buyer sees your address as the pickup location

Perfect for: furniture, large items, fresh food, or any product you don't want to ship.
product.weight_dimensions_learn_more: How weight & dimensions affect shipping cost
product.weight_dimensions_info_body:
Accurate weight and dimensions help calculate fair shipping rates.

How pricing works:
• Carriers use the greater of actual weight vs dimensional weight
• Dimensional weight = (L × W × H) ÷ 5000 (in cm/kg)
• Example: A box 40×30×20 cm = 4.8 kg dimensional

If your product is light but bulky, you may pay more than expected. Enter accurate dimensions to avoid surprises.

Tip: Measure the packaged product, not just the product itself.
product.supplier_cost_banner: Track supplier cost below. Selling prices are always in CAD.
product.supplier_tracking_body:
Does your supplier provide tracking numbers?

When enabled:
• You can enter tracking numbers for each order
• Buyers receive shipping updates automatically
• Helps reduce "where is my order?" inquiries

Most suppliers (AliExpress, Amazon, etc.) provide tracking. Smaller local suppliers may not.
product.inventory_management_body:
Controls whether stock levels are tracked for this product.

ON (recommended for most):
• Stock decreases automatically on each sale
• Low stock alerts notify you when to restock
• Product is hidden when stock reaches 0

OFF (for dropship products):
• Stock is never tracked — unlimited availability
• Your supplier fulfills orders directly

Tip: Turn OFF if using AliExpress or similar dropship suppliers.
product.track_quantity_info_body:
When ON, stock counts down with each sale and the product becomes unavailable at 0.

When OFF, the product always shows as "in stock" regardless of orders. Useful for made-to-order or digital-like physical products.

Note: Only applies when Manage Inventory is also ON.
product.allow_backorders_info_body:
When enabled, buyers can still place orders even when stock is 0.

This is useful if:
• You can restock quickly from your supplier
• You accept pre-orders
• You manufacture on demand

The buyer will NOT be warned — update your product description if fulfillment may be delayed.
product.bulk_discount_info_body:
Encourage bigger orders by offering progressive shipping discounts.

How tiers work:
• 3+ items: A percentage off shipping (e.g. 20% off)
• 5+ items: A bigger percentage (e.g. 50% off)
• 10+ items: Free shipping entirely

Additional item cost: Extra shipping per item beyond the first (e.g. $1.50/item for heavier products).

Max per shipment: Limit items per package. Set to 0 for unlimited. If a buyer orders more, multiple shipments are created automatically.
product.bulk_free_shipping_body:
When enabled, buyers who order 10 or more units get completely free shipping.

This is a powerful incentive for wholesale and repeat customers. Stacks with your 3+ and 5+ discount tiers.

Note: At least one delivery tier (Standard, Express, or Same-Day) must be enabled for this to take effect.
product.multi_item_learn_more: What do these multi-item fields mean?
product.multi_item_shipping_body:
Cost per extra item: Additional shipping charge for each item beyond the first (e.g. $1.50). Set to $0 if no extra cost.

Max per shipment: Maximum items that fit in one package. Set to 0 for unlimited. If a buyer orders more, multiple shipments are created automatically.

Example: Max 5/shipment + $1.50/extra → 7 items = 2 shipments, first at base + 4×$1.50, second at base + 1×$1.50.
product.margin_warning: ⚠ Supplier cost in {currency} — margin is approximate until converted to CAD.
product.discount_validation: 5+ items discount must be ≥ 3+ items discount

cart.sign_in_subtitle: Your cart items will be saved to your account.
cart.service_fee_tooltip: Platform fee of {percent}% to keep the service secure and reliable.
cart.service_fee_info:
A {percent}% commission is applied to each transaction to cover:

• Secure payments via Stripe
• Buyer and seller protection
• Technical infrastructure
• Customer support

This amount is automatically deducted from the seller's payment.
cart.tax_tooltip: Taxes (GST/HST/PST) will be calculated at checkout based on your province.
cart.tax_info:
Taxes are calculated automatically at checkout based on:

• Your delivery province
• Product type (some categories are exempt)

Applicable taxes:
• GST (5%): All provinces
• PST (6-7%): BC, MB, SK
• QST (9.975%): QC
• HST (13-15%): ON (13%), NS (14%), NB, NL, PE (15%)

Children's products and certain food items may be exempt from PST depending on the province.
cart.delivery_hint:

Ring the intercom, apartment 12
Delivery after 2 PM only
